useDarkMode

This hook helps to handles dark or light mode on the app.

Example
import useDarkMode from '@/utils/hooks/useDarkMode'

const Component = () => {

	const [isDark, setIsDark] = useDarkMode()

	const handleSetDarkMode = (bool) => {
		setIsDark(bool ? 'dark' : 'light')
	}
	return (...)
}

RETURN	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
isDark	Whether the current mode is dark mode	boolean	-
setIsDark	Mode setter	(mode: 'dark' | 'light') => void	-
